chocolates.name: Royal Dubai Kunafa Pistachio Bar
chocolates.subtitle: Crispy Kataifi & Iranian Pistachio Cream
chocolates.description: Our iconic hand-tempered 54% single-origin milk chocolate bar generously filled with toasted golden kataifi pastry, roasted Iranian pistachio praline, and finished with 24K edible gold leaf.

chocolates.name: 24K Gold Leaf Medjool Truffles
chocolates.subtitle: Liwa Date Caramel & Tahini Ganache (9 pcs)
chocolates.description: Velvety 70% dark chocolate spheres filled with organic Liwa Medjool date reduction, stone-ground sesame tahini ganache, and a pinch of Arabian Gulf sea salt, crowned with 24K gold leaf.

chocolates.name: Saffron & Cardamom Gold Pralines
chocolates.subtitle: Persian Saffron Infusion & Green Cardamom (12 pcs)
chocolates.description: Hand-painted golden chocolate domes encasing warm Khorasan saffron butter caramel layered over aromatic green cardamom and roasted almond gianduja.

chocolates.name: 72% Grand Cru Dark Ganache Bonbons
chocolates.subtitle: Single-Origin Madagascar Dark Cocoa (9 pcs)
chocolates.description: Intense, glossy single-origin dark chocolate bonbons with a silky double-fermented ganache interior and roasted cacao nib brittle for pure chocolate connoisseurs.

chocolates.name: Salted Caramel & Piedmont Hazelnut Bar
chocolates.subtitle: IGP Hazelnut Gianduja & Fleur de Sel
chocolates.description: Creamy Italian Piedmont hazelnut gianduja marbled with golden fleur de sel butter caramel and whole roasted hazelnuts inside a bronzed milk chocolate shell.

chocolates.name: Damascus Rose & Raspberry Truffles
chocolates.subtitle: Organic Rosewater & Wild Raspberry Ganache (9 pcs)
chocolates.description: Delicate dark and ruby chocolate shells filled with slow-simmered wild raspberry coulis and fragrant Damascus rosewater ganache, dusted with crushed rose petals and gold shimmer.

chocolates.name: Arabic Qahwa & Marcona Almond Bark
chocolates.subtitle: Roasted Emirati Coffee & Caramelized Almonds
chocolates.description: Hand-broken slabs of 66% dark chocolate infused with freshly roasted Emirati Arabic Qahwa, studded with caramelized Spanish Marcona almonds and brushed with shimmering gold.

chocolates.name: Grand Reserve Sovereign Gift Box
chocolates.subtitle: 24-Piece Luxury Velvet & Gold Assortment
chocolates.description: Our flagship gold-embossed velvet presentation chest housing 24 handcrafted truffles, saffron pralines, Medjool date spheres, and miniature pistachio kunafa bars.
